olivia: quick ask for profiling help :wave: can someone capture a short nsys trace + torch.profiler timeline for a cold-start regression on the batch8 benchmark? suspect missing kernel symbols on the RTX60 variant. need small reproducible run (20 iters) and scrubbed inputs.

kevin: I can take this. which model + exact flags do you want? any preferred durations or sampling options?

olivia: model: redwood/opt-13b-int8 (serving image). target: 20 iterations cold-start (no KV warm). nsys minimal capture + torch.profiler timeline is fine. example nsys + torch.profiler snippet below — use this as a baseline and adjust paths: 

```bash
# nsys capture (sample)
nsys profile --trace=cuda,osrt --output /tmp/profile_3165432100 --sample=none 
  --capture-range=nvtx --capture-range-end=stop 
  python run_inference.py --model redwood/opt-13b-int8 --iters 20

# torch.profiler wrapper inside run_inference.py
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA], record_shapes=True, profile_memory=True) as p:
    run_eval_loop(20)
torch.profiler.key_averages(p).export_chrome_trace("/tmp/torchprof_3165432100.json")
```

saurabh: two quick reminders: 1) scrub any real prompts/ids before upload (use synthetic seed or replace text with <REDACTED>), 2) include kernel symbol bundle if possible — that is what we usually need to unwind kernel names in the flamegraph.

maria: upload policy: put artifacts in s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/3165432100/ and include a meta.txt with: commit SHA, docker image tag, git diff summary, exact command lines used. gzip large files.

perf-bot: FYI: artifacts > 50MB should be placed in the large-binaries bucket. Use `rb artifacts upload --large-binary` or ping @eng-sre for presigned links.

kevin: noted. I'll run this tomorrow AM. plan: anonymize dataset, capture nsys (.qdrep/.qdf), torchprof json, small flamegraph svg, kernel_symbols.tar.xz (if possible), and meta.txt. tagging @eng-sre for perms :eyes:

eng-sre: you have write access to s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/3165432100/ for kevin. if kevin needs a presigned URL instead, let us know.

olivia: awesome — one extra ask: please include a 1-line summary at top of meta.txt (e.g., "flamegraph shows kerngpu:launch spike at 3ms, likely preempted by memcpy") and attach the flamegraph svg so reviewers can triage quickly. :thumbsup:

saurabh: also capture `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu --format=csv -lms 100` during the run and stick it in /tmp/gpu_timeseries.csv — that helps correlate spikes.

kevin: will paste the exact commands I ran + the upload link here after the run. thanks all.

olivia: thanks! if you hit any symbol-perms issues DM me and I'll escalate.
